title: Reach, Target, Safety Classifier
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Classify a college as a reach, target, or safety for you from your GPA and test score, its admission rate and middle 50% ranges, and its financial fit.

learningObjectives: Students will apply admission-rate, middle 50% range, and affordability criteria to classify colleges as reach, target, or safety schools for themselves.

keyQuestions: Why is a college with a 6% admission rate a reach even for a student with top scores?
Why isn't a likely admission enough to make a college a safety?
What would you need to check before calling a college affordable?
commonMisconceptions: High scores make any college a safety.
A safety is any college that will probably admit you, whatever it costs.
assessmentOpportunities: Students classify three colleges correctly using the five rules and name the deciding rule for each.
